title: Analytic manifolds of compact-group Banach-Lie one-cocycles with split tangent spaces and locally analytic conjugacy sections
author: Alexandru Chirvasitu; Jun Peng
work: Manifolds of Lie-Group-Valued Cocycles and Discrete Cohomology
source_version: Official SIGMA 19 (2023) article 106, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2023.106; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proof handles the nonlinear cocycle equations in exponential coordinates and controls their Baker-Campbell-Hausdorff defect quadratically. Haar averaging gives a bounded cochain correction, allowing an analytic cocycle chart and a complemented tangent space for the cocycle-twisted action. It then proves that the nonlinear conjugacy map is a split submersion, obtaining both discrete cohomology and an analytic local choice of conjugators.

source_check.note: Full Theorem3.2 and Lemma3.1 are supplied. G is compact Hausdorff and acts jointly continuously by analytic automorphisms on a real or complex Banach Lie group U, with the uniform topology on continuous cochains. The tangent-space action is twisted by the selected cocycle; it cannot be replaced by the untwisted action. The source explicitly constructs the exponential/BCH correction and chart, invokes the standard analytic inverse/submersion theorem, and gives the local analytic conjugacy section argument. The author states the inverse chart step from the quadratic correction without expanding it; this is a bounded routine analytic step after the explicit construction, not an omitted new theorem. Higher abelian cocycles, relative central cocycles and algebra-morphism corollaries are not separate counted units. Source approval supplied only by exact frozen root input; no new source/difficulty decision or mathematical referee.
